instruction: Candid documentary medium shot of a cozy indoor room. The man with white hair and beard (R1) sits at a table wearing a brown knit sweater, smiling warmly. The woman with gray hair (R2) in a white shirt stands behind him, leaning over to wrap her arms around his neck and shoulders. On the table in front of them are pill organizers and medicine packets. Soft natural light filters in from a window, creating a gentle, intimate atmosphere.
elements: R2 stands behind R1 and wraps her arms around R1's neck and shoulders
R1 is seated and receives the embrace while R2 is the one leaning over him
R1 remains seated at the table while R2 stands behind him in contact with his shoulders
pill organizers on the table in front of them
